title: GETTING IT RIGHT FOR TWO YEAR OLDS : A PENNY TASSONI HANDBOOK
author: Tassoni, Penny
summary: Match provision to this age group's unique needs with this indispensable guide by Penny Tassoni which is ideal for both students and settings expanding its two year old intake. Written by the leading author in Childcare and Early Years education, this is an informative, fun and above all practical handbook. In addition to answering educators' questions about how best to work with this age range and earn a good Ofsted rating, it treats with enthusiasm the challenging characteristics of two year olds and provides many ideas for activities and planning and creating optimal environments for them. - Addresses physical, emotional, behavioural and other developmental patterns with numerous examples so you can prepare more detailed and precise assessments - Provides guidance on how to carry out the two year old progress check and work with parents and other professionals to support development - Includes tips on overcoming tantrums, fussy eating and other issues common with this age group - Considers how to manage when two year olds are in environments with older children - Includes activities linked to the EYFS which focus on each of the prime areas.
